Upstream paths are relative to the repository root at the pinned commit.

updatePolicy.description: No automated watcher exists for this source; the adaptation is small and concept-level. Re-reading the watched files and advancing `commit` is a manual, reviewed local change.

localChanges: Separates black-box public-interface verification from source-informed change-impact investigation, and labels implementation reading as test selection rather than black-box execution.
Requires expected results to come from the contract (acceptance criteria, spec, docs), never from the implementation under test.
Folds `blast-radius` in as the change-impact reference and `create-verification-skill` in as the project-recipe reference, each with an explicit open-when trigger.
Planning stays read-only: execution-level proof is recorded as a verification step for implementation authority instead of being run during planning.
The skill grants no install, live write, outbound message, or process-launch authority; existing workflow gates remain authoritative.
Requires every substituted and untested boundary to be named, and refuses to count a failing setup as a reproduced regression.
Recipe placement is a recorded decision that reuses existing project docs first, instead of unconditionally generating `.claude/skills/verify/`.
Routed conditionally from `issue-plan` (unproven cross-boundary safety assumptions) and `issue-work` (observable public-interface behavior); no gate for trivial, internal, or documentation changes.
acceptedUpstreamRules: Find the one or two facts a change is safe because of and prove them by running code, not by writing them up.
The proof ladder: asserted, pointed at, reasoned, executed, reproduced in the running application; report where each fact stopped.
Look where grep stops: library source and pinned version, execution timing, payloads, columns, wire formats, flags.
Report confirmed risks separately from cleared ones; a search that found nothing is an answer; never invent a caller or API.
A recipe covers launch with usable readiness, a read-only doctor check, a real drive with stable handles, evidence, and cleanup.
Exercise the real user path, not internal setters or test-only endpoints; mocks only where a production boundary already isolates the external system.
Read back side effects and verify by observation what a dry run actually skips.
Kill only what the run started, never by process name; cleanup never deletes the evidence.
A journey whose precondition is missing reports the gap; it is never weakened to pass.
A generated recipe is proven once end to end before it is called done; a stand-in target leaves its target-only steps unverified.
rejectedUpstreamRules: Running a wide change as an `arena` across multiple models — no additional reviewer or model fan-out; review stays with the owning workflow.
Always naming the generated skill `verify` under `.claude/skills/` to shadow Claude Code's built-in; placement is chosen per project and must be visible to every runtime.
Fixing a broken checkout or creating scaffolding assets before generating a recipe without separate authority.
The `maintain-verification-skill` loop and a feature-map directory per project as a default; a recipe stays as small as the project's real need.
Writing the report through `unslop` and the poteto-mode playbooks, autonomy, and shipping flow that surround these skills upstream.
Plugin installation, slash-command stubs, and hooks; distribution is the local skill reconciler only.
